text: Verifier-guided inference-time search for language models. We introduce a search algorithm that uses formal proof feedback to select candidate reasoning traces, with ablations and benchmark evaluation.
A type-theoretic framework for proof-producing program synthesis. The method constructs terms by backward chaining in dependent type theory and proves soundness.
Formal verification of neural network controllers with abstract interpretation. We derive reachable-state bounds and verify safety properties for nonlinear systems.
Sparse mixture-of-experts transformers for efficient language model training. A routing architecture reduces compute while preserving perplexity and downstream accuracy.
Optimization methods for decentralized federated learning under communication constraints. We establish convergence rates and evaluate the algorithm on distributed benchmarks.
A minimax theory of adaptive confidence intervals for high-dimensional regression. We prove lower bounds and construct an estimator attaining the optimal rate.
The complexity of deciding equivalence in a fragment of dependent type theory. We give a decision procedure, prove termination, and establish a matching lower bound.
Rectified flow models for high-resolution image generation. We derive a transport objective and compare sampling algorithms on standard image benchmarks.
An event-driven architecture for low-latency vector search systems. The system design combines indexing and memory allocation algorithms and is evaluated under load.
Statistical guarantees for conformal prediction with distribution shift. We prove finite-sample coverage bounds and validate the procedure on controlled experiments.
Proof search with learned heuristics in Lean. A policy ranks tactic applications and a verifier checks every generated proof; experiments report theorem-proving success rates.
A finite-element method for an inverse problem governed by elliptic partial differential equations. We establish stability and convergence in Sobolev norms.
Approximation algorithms for submodular maximization on dynamic graphs. We prove approximation ratios and analyze update time.
Risk-sensitive portfolio optimization with order-book features. We formulate a stochastic control problem and evaluate a calibrated predictor against quantitative baselines.
Benchmarking tool-using language model agents with executable formal semantics. Tasks are generated from typed programs and scored by exact execution outcomes.
Multimodal representation learning with cross-attention between images and speech. The model objective aligns paired embeddings and improves retrieval benchmarks.
A proof of a new bound on random matrix eigenvalues using concentration inequalities. The argument yields a sharper asymptotic rate for sparse matrices.
Memory reclamation algorithms for concurrent storage engines. We prove linearizability and measure throughput and tail latency on multicore systems.
Bayesian inference for hierarchical models using a variational message-passing algorithm. We analyze approximation error and compare posterior estimates.
A federated multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm with regret guarantees. Agents exchange compressed gradients and converge under nonstationary rewards.
University students' perceptions of large language models in coursework. Semi-structured interviews identify themes in trust, motivation, and academic integrity.
Teachers' adoption of generative AI in secondary education: a survey of perceived usefulness, workload, and institutional support.
Ethical governance of autonomous AI agents. We review accountability principles and propose recommendations for public institutions.
Public attitudes toward artificial intelligence in health care. A qualitative study analyzes interviews about trust, privacy, and consent.
Organizational responses to algorithmic decision systems. Case studies describe worker experiences and changes to professional practice.
The societal impact of machine learning in schools. This policy analysis discusses equity, procurement, and regulation.
How researchers understand responsible AI: an interview study of norms, incentives, and institutional governance.
A review of philosophical arguments about artificial intelligence and human creativity. The paper examines concepts of authorship and agency.
Parents' views on automated tutoring systems. Focus groups explore concerns about children's independence and privacy.
AI adoption and productivity in public agencies: evidence from a survey of managers and policy staff.
Media framing of autonomous vehicles and artificial intelligence. A qualitative content analysis examines public narratives and risk perception.
Ethics education for data scientists: instructors' experiences and curriculum choices across universities.
Community perceptions of predictive policing tools. Interviews document legitimacy concerns and demands for oversight.
A comparative policy review of generative AI regulation in higher education. We summarize institutional guidance and unresolved governance questions.
How patients make sense of AI-assisted diagnosis. The study uses thematic analysis of interviews about responsibility and communication.
The labor-market implications of automation: a sociological analysis of worker narratives and organizational change.
Public perceptions of language models and misinformation. A questionnaire measures awareness, concern, and media literacy.
A humanities analysis of artificial intelligence in contemporary literature, focusing on agency, identity, and cultural meaning.
Student and teacher attitudes toward automated feedback tools. Survey responses describe classroom acceptance and perceived fairness.
Governance challenges for multi-agent AI in society. We discuss accountability gaps and international policy options.
Quantization-aware training for compact language models. We derive a mixed-precision objective and measure accuracy, memory use, and inference latency.
A sublinear algorithm for approximate nearest-neighbor search in high-dimensional spaces. We prove query and memory bounds and evaluate recall on benchmark datasets.
A decidable fragment of higher-order logic for verified synthesis. We provide a completeness theorem and an implementation in a proof assistant.
Robust optimization for distributionally shifted image classification. The method minimizes a worst-case empirical risk and is tested across corruption benchmarks.
An asymptotic limit theorem for dependent random variables. We establish convergence rates using coupling and martingale methods.
A SAT solver based on conflict-driven clause learning with proof certificates. We prove certificate soundness and compare runtime on standard instances.
Causal representation learning with identifiable latent variables. We state sufficient assumptions and evaluate recovery error in synthetic and real data.
A parallel runtime for heterogeneous accelerators. The scheduling algorithm improves utilization and is evaluated on scientific workloads.
Statistical decision theory for sparse inverse problems. We derive minimax risk bounds and construct an estimator that attains them.
A decentralized algorithm for cooperative agents with communication delays. We prove a sublinear regret guarantee under partial observability.
Calibrated machine learning for limit-order-book prediction. We evaluate probabilistic forecasts, transaction-cost-adjusted returns, and risk across markets.
A benchmark for code-generating language models with unit tests and execution-based scoring. We specify tasks, baselines, and reproducible evaluation protocols.
Farmers' attitudes toward generative AI in agricultural extension. Interviews describe perceived usefulness, trust, and access barriers.
A policy analysis of automated decision systems in local government. We compare procurement rules, oversight practices, and accountability mechanisms.
How university faculty negotiate generative AI policies. Focus groups reveal disagreements about learning, authorship, and assessment.
Public sentiment about machine learning in financial services. A nationally representative survey measures trust and perceived consumer risk.
A legal review of responsibility for decisions made by autonomous AI agents. We analyze statutes and propose governance principles.
Narratives of algorithmic bias in hiring. A qualitative media study examines fairness claims and public controversy.
The meaning of artificial intelligence in contemporary art criticism. This humanities essay examines authorship and cultural imagination.
Teachers' experiences using automated writing feedback. Thematic coding of interviews describes classroom practice and concerns.
Organizational adoption of decision support software in hospitals. Interviews explore professional autonomy and institutional change.
An ethics framework for generative AI in public services. We discuss values, stakeholder responsibilities, and governance options.
Parents' and students' views on AI tutoring. Survey analysis reports awareness, comfort, and concerns about privacy.
A comparative study of national AI strategies and their approach to innovation, labor, and public accountability.
We prove a sharp upper bound for the chromatic number of sparse random graphs using a probabilistic argument.
A memory-efficient optimizer for training transformer networks. Convergence is analyzed and performance is measured on public benchmarks.
An executable semantics for multi-agent planning with typed tool calls. A soundness theorem guarantees that accepted traces satisfy the specification.
The training data include anonymized student responses, but the contribution is a federated optimization algorithm with convergence guarantees and bandwidth evaluation.
A finite-sample analysis of Bayesian variable selection under model misspecification. We establish posterior contraction rates.
An event-time simulator for limit order books. We specify the matching algorithm and compare predictive models on held-out market data.
A proof of normalization for a dependent type calculus with effects. The result follows from a logical-relations argument.
A new numerical method for solving nonlinear partial differential equations, with stability analysis and convergence experiments.
A survey of university students' views on language-model accuracy, fairness, and the effects on learning.
An interview study of software engineers' perceptions of AI code assistants and changes to professional identity.
Policy recommendations for responsible autonomous systems, based on a review of governance frameworks and accountability principles.
Teachers' perspectives on AI tutoring tools, analyzed through qualitative interviews and classroom observations.
A humanities study of algorithmic authorship and cultural value in generative media.
The paper uses a regression model to analyze public attitudes toward machine-learning decisions in welfare services.
A comparative governance analysis of federated learning deployments in public institutions.
Organizational case studies of how doctors interpret AI risk scores and negotiate responsibility for patient care.
Formal semantics for tool-using language-model agents. We define typed action traces and prove soundness of a verifier for executable agent plans.
A new theorem on spectral gaps of random graphs, with a proof based on martingale concentration and an asymptotically tight bound.
A learned index for distributed vector databases. The architecture is evaluated for throughput, memory use, and query latency.
Machine learning for options pricing under stochastic volatility. We derive a constrained estimator and compare out-of-sample pricing error and calibration.
Formal verification of a compiler optimization using refinement types. The proof establishes semantic preservation for every transformed program.
A mathematical analysis of adaptive algorithms for online convex optimization. We prove a regret bound without assumptions on strong convexity.
Education data are used as an incidental example in evaluating a new federated gradient compression algorithm. Convergence is proved and benchmark results are reported.
Efficient diffusion sampling through adaptive numerical integration. We derive an error bound for the solver and evaluate generated samples.
Interviews with university students about how language models change study habits, assessment, and their sense of authorship.
A survey of school leaders on generative AI policy, procurement, and teacher training needs.
Ethical governance of autonomous AI agents: a conceptual analysis of accountability and public oversight.
Public attitudes toward machine learning in clinical practice, measured through focus groups and thematic coding.
A sociology of algorithmic management examining employee perceptions, workplace power, and organizational responses.
Policy options for artificial intelligence in education, comparing regulatory documents and institutional guidance.
A humanities perspective on language models and authorship, based on close reading of contemporary literary criticism.
Teachers' experiences with AI tutoring platforms, reported through qualitative interviews and thematic analysis.
